selection_policy: Every property predicate remains UNRESOLVED; no inferred facts or application-safe output.

predicates.LEGAL_LOT_STATUS: Legal lot criteria and documentary determination under §113.0237(a); never inferred from parcel size.
predicates.LOT_AREA: Legally relevant lot/premises area, not supplied or measured here.
predicates.MULTI_ZONE_PREMISES: Whether premises spans zones and the legally relevant area in each zone.
predicates.DEVELOPMENT_USE_CLASS: Single/multiple dwelling development or visitor accommodation; no use authorization inferred.
predicates.COMMUNITY_PLAN_AREA: Whether La Jolla, Pacific Beach or Torrey Pines footnote36 applies.
predicates.ALLEY_SERVICE_AND_GEOMETRY: Whether served by an abutting alley, width and credit area; no geometry inferred.
predicates.SUBDIVISION_OR_EXISTING_LOT: Proposed subdivision versus existing legal lot; no subdivision permission inferred.
predicates.OTHER_REGULATORY_CONTROLS: Overlays, supplemental rules, permits, grandfathering, and special programs not determined.
predicates.REQUIRED_DEDICATION: Whether street/alley dedication is required under142.0610 and verified pre-dedication regulatory lines; no line or area is inferred.

coastal_context.purpose: Version gate; no outside inference from missing data

property_line_roles.purpose: Legal front/interior/street-side/rear classification, including corner/double-fronted/triangular geometry

lot_width_ft.purpose: 113.0243 measured lot width; never table minimum substituted for measured width

cul_de_sac_frontage_portion.purpose: Whether the relevant portion of the lot fronts a cul-de-sac

front_50ft_fraction_at_least_25pct_slope.purpose: Table131-04D footnote1 test: at least0.5 of front50ft lot depth has minimum25%gradient

setback_is_closest_to_street_frontage.purpose: Identifies the setback eligible for Table131-04D footnote1

side_reallocation_elected.purpose: 131.0443(a)(4)(B) is an optional reallocation; never presume election

proposed_side_setback_dimensions_ft.purpose: Combined-dimension constraint under side reallocation; distinguishes interior and street-side floors

fire_official_defensible_space_buffer.meaning: Whether Fire Code Official requires a greater defensible-space buffer under131.0443(i); unknown does not mean no added buffer. No actual setback line is selected.

alley_property_line_special_mapping.meaning: O-21836 clean p14 omits codified 113.0246(e)(1)-(3) and Diagram 113-02CC without a no-change clause. No deletion or retention interpretation is made.

required_street_or_alley_dedication.meaning: Whether street/alley dedication is required under142.0610 remains unresolved. Height setback-line scope excludes that context because the separate setback sentence is defective. FAR retains only the independently verified opening density/GFA pre-dedication sentence, conditional on this predicate.

completely_underground_structure.meaning: 113.0252(b) underground exemption cites 113.0461; no substituted reference or exemption is promoted.

resubdivided_corner_lot.meaning: 113.0246(f) retains original front/street-side setbacks and remaps other lines to interior-side; historical geometry is outside this proposed profile, not presumed absent.

document_modified_setback.meaning: 113.0249(b)-(c) ordinance, approved subdivision, survey or division plat can control; the document-specific line is not determined here.

existing_primary_structure_addition.meaning: 113.0249(d) and 131.0443(a)(4)(B)(i) require established side setbacks to continue in additions; no existing legal line is determined here.

accessory_structure_standard.meaning: 131.0448/141.0307 and program-specific standards are not certified by this primary-building parameter.

projection_or_encroachment.meaning: 131.0461(a) permits specified projections/encroachments subject to element-specific conditions; this profile describes the base setback, not those permissions.

special_program_or_overlay_modification.meaning: 131.0430(a) preserves Chapter13 Article2 and Chapter14 controls; this profile establishes no overlay waiver, exception, incentive, or compliance outcome.

corner_lot_status.purpose: Interior-side proposals are scoped to non-corner lots, so the standard lot-width threshold is not silently selected over the separate corner-width row.

source: measurement:26 opening GFA dedication sentence only
LEGAL_LOT_AND_PREMISES_GEOMETRY.meaning: Unresolved legal lot/premises and regulatory geometry inputs; no assessor geometry presumed controlling. This predicate does not certify any disputed property-line mapping chain.

MEASURED_RESIDENTIAL_LOT_WIDTH_FT.meaning: Width measured under 113.0243, including irregular/consolidated-lot rules.

APPLICABLE_REQUIRED_YARD_AND_SETBACK.meaning: Unresolved applicable required side/front/street-side yard and setback line within the expressly bounded ordinary above-grade primary-building context. No actual line is selected; disputed mappings and special contexts remain excluded by named unresolved predicates.

MAXIMUM_STRUCTURE_HEIGHT_EXCEEDS_27_FT.meaning: The express 131.0444(c) condition for front/street-side angled planes; no value selected.

EXISTING_AND_PROPOSED_GRADE.meaning: Lower of existing/proposed grade plus footprint/adjacent grade and special measurement circumstances.

STRUCTURE_AND_APPURTENANCE_CHARACTERISTI.meaning: Structure, separation, subterranean areas, pool and proposed projection/encroachment characteristics.

OVERLAY_AND_SUPPLEMENTAL_APPLICABILITY.meaning: Applicable Chapter 13 Article 2 and Chapter 14 regulations; outside Coastal does not mean no other overlays.

PREMISES_STEEP_HILLSIDE_AREA_FRACTION.meaning: Fraction of premises that meets complete steep-hillsides definition, not merely average slope.

NATURAL_GRADIENT_AND_ELEVATION_DIFFERENT.meaning: Steep hillsides: gradient >=25% AND elevation differential >=50ft, OR gradient >=200% AND differential >=10ft.

LOT_COVERAGE_FOOTPRINT_AND_EXCLUSIONS.meaning: Footprint measured at outer walls/supports; each 113.0240(a)-(e) exclusion remains subject to its conditions.

GROSS_FLOOR_AREA_ELEMENTS.meaning: Included/excluded floor elements and type of development under 113.0234; not assessor building area.

source: measurement:26 opening density/GFA pre-dedication sentence only
TOTAL_PREMISES_AREA_SQFT.meaning: Unresolved regulatory total premises area. Any required-dedication dependency is confined to the exact opening density/GFA sentence of113.0246; no broader line-mapping or setback-dedication interpretation is certified.

GARAGE_FLOOR_AREA_SQFT.meaning: Garage area relevant to up-to-400-sf exclusion; no area assumed.
